release_gates: Regenerate and verify convex/_generated from the configured protected Convex deployment; local `npx convex codegen --dry-run` could not run because CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT is intentionally absent.
Apply schema/index changes and any identity, membership, and lead tenant backfill in protected non-production infrastructure before release.
Configure isolated Preview WorkOS and Vercel Blob credentials separately in Vercel and Convex; never reuse Production values.
Run signed WorkOS webhook create/update/delete, anonymous protected-route redirects, realistic hostile/cross-issuer identity tests, and disabled-user denial against the protected preview.
Run private Blob upload/head/finalize/download/delete and hostile MIME, size, pathname, tenant, role, and job-assignment tests against the protected preview.
Require green CI/security statuses, independent approval, and protected-preview anonymous smoke tests before merge or release.
limitations: No live Convex deployment, WorkOS tenant, Vercel Blob store, production credentials, or production data was accessed.
Cross-issuer subject collision was not reproduced against live accepted WorkOS issuers; tokenIdentifier binding and preview hostile-identity verification remain required.
notes: Independent evaluation initially returned remediation for legacy public RPC authorization, role overgrant, role-aware UI query failures, legacy membership migration compatibility, public document association leakage, unenforced WorkOS route protection, copied placeholder signing/cookie secrets, dead deployment environment validation, redirect mismatch, and a TypeScript regression in the proxy tests. Each was corrected and independently reverified. The final committed source was rechecked at exact SHA 137f2eebf899d4ccf101594063083529df039d9f in a clean, lockfile-isolated detached worktree. The code-level node passes; deployment-effect validation remains explicitly gated.
